design: 256 shared Latin-hypercube settings, seed 32, original ranges unchanged
selection: Training rows only; exclude unverified/stylised. Accept when second-largest standardized gap <=2.5 on both seeds. Rank by indicator-balanced Huber loss (delta=1). Missing eligible observations receive infinite loss. If none accepted, mark unmatched and show the five least-loss settings.
anchoring: Targets through 2015 only; no target correction during search/evaluation
evaluation: Compare original and selected settings on identical seeds and instruments; report training/post-2015 separately and mechanism-only runs. Never select using evaluation results.
claim: Retrospective temporal evaluation conditional on coded historical paths/events. Post-2015 observations have already been inspected. No new blind-experiment claim.
unchanged: No country-specific mechanism edits, tolerance widening or observation changes.

refinement.reason: First-pass training errors increased on other simulation seeds, indicating seed sensitivity. This amendment is recorded after first-pass evaluation; no newly blind claim is made.
refinement.design: four first-pass leaders + original incumbent + eight shared normalized +/-10% range perturbations around each winner/incumbent; perturbation seed 3202
refinement.selection: Same training-only objective and acceptance threshold. Do not select using post-2015 outcomes.
